main.summary: Describes indexed filters for server-side transfer session queries.

property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Gets the optional item identifier filter.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Gets the optional session identifier filter.

property.name: CatalogName
property.summary: Gets the catalog filter, required for tenant-scoped session queries and optional only for admin inventory.

property.name: SourceSessionID
property.summary: Gets the optional source session identifier filter.

property.name: Status
property.summary: Gets the optional transfer status filter.

property.name: Family
property.summary: Gets the optional transfer family filter.
